style_frames.brief: Bright ivory editorial frame with one ordinary company laptop as hero, cobalt paper block, brass micro-accent, subtle print grain, 35-55% negative space, refined Arabic editorial headline area, no dark background.
Warm ivory paper evidence frame using a generic official document fragment, cobalt side field, brass highlight strokes, source/date area, no fabricated real-event imagery, document-first composition.
Ivory illustrated map composition showing a laptop anchored in the U.S. and a distant anonymous human marker elsewhere, thin cobalt route, brass endpoint, printed-map texture, no globe, no neon.

Ivory editorial mechanism frame where one fictional employee portrait/card separates into identity, interview, device, location, work, and account fragments; cobalt structure, brass annotations, classical/botanical cutout accents only as secondary texture.

rejection_rule: Any frame that becomes dark-first, cinematic-noir, dashboard-like, cyberpunk, or generic AI art is rejected before Owner review.
